metadata.name: lite_psm
metadata.description: LitePSM - USDC to OkuMoney peg stability module

instructions.name: accept_role_admin
docs: Step 2 of the two-step `RoleAdmin` rotation. Must be signed by the
`pending_role_admin` previously proposed via `set_authority(RoleAdmin,
new_admin)`. See `instructions::psm_admin::accept_role_admin`.

`direct_burner` only). Matches EVM `OkuMoney.burn(amount)` called
by a non-PSM `OKUM_BURNER`. Enables SVM->EVM bridging.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint (standard SPL).
Must have exactly `TOKEN_DECIMALS` (= 6) decimals on Solana —
this matches the `OkuMoney`/`usdOku` decimal model. EVM resolves
a runtime `usdcDecimalMultiplier` from `IERC20Metadata.decimals()`;
SVM hardcodes the value via the shared constant and asserts at
init.

accounts.name: oku_money_mint
docs: OkuMoney mint (Token-2022).
At init we lock down both authorities to the PSM config PDA so that
no EOA can mint or freeze OkuMoney post-deployment. Without these
constraints, a misconfigured deploy could initialize PSM against a
mint whose authority is a different program / multisig, silently
breaking supply accounting.
Decimals are pinned at `TOKEN_DECIMALS` (= 6) — all PSM math
(`oku_m_price`, `oku_m_to_dollars`, yield distribution) assumes
6-decimal raw amounts. Cycle 4: replaced the literal `6` with
the shared constant so a future re-decimalisation can't drift
the assertion away from the assumed precision.

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault

instructions.name: migrate_psm_config
docs: One-time migration: extend PsmConfig from 674 -> 714 bytes to
accommodate the `direct_minter` + `direct_minter_allowance` fields.

instructions.name: mint_oku_m
docs: Mint OkuMoney with USDC (price-aware)
oku_m_amount = usdc_amount * PRECISION / oku_m_price

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint

accounts.name: oku_money_mint
docs: OkuMoney mint (Token-2022). The program is extension-agnostic; the deploy
script chooses which extensions (if any) are configured at mint creation.
`mint::authority = config` is defense-in-depth: even if someone attempted
an out-of-band mint-authority rotation (which requires a CPI signed by
the current authority = config PDA, so it cannot happen without the
program's consent), this constraint would catch it at deserialization.

accounts.name: oku_money_mint

accounts.name: vault_oku_money

mint→wrap atomic flow. The OkuMoney is minted here and immediately
transferred to the oku-dollar reserve vault via the `wrap_to` CPI,

accounts.name: recipient

accounts.name: oku_dollar_config

accounts.name: dead_shares_ata

accounts.name: redemption_queue

accounts.name: oku_money_mint

`mint::authority = config` is defense-in-depth (see rationale on

docs: PSM's USDC vault

accounts.name: vault_oku_money

instructions.name: redeem_oku_m
docs: Redeem OkuMoney for USDC (price-aware)
usdc_amount = oku_m_amount * oku_m_price / PRECISION

accounts.name: redemption_queue
docs: Redemption queue (zero-copy ring buffer). Use `load_mut()` to enqueue,
`load()` for read-only inspection. The handler is responsible for
dropping the borrow before any CPI that re-borrows the account info.
The `bump = redemption_queue.load()?.bump` constraint pattern is
awkward in Anchor's derive; we instead use the canonical
`bump` lookup (Anchor will recompute it from seeds).

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint

accounts.name: oku_money_mint
docs: OkuMoney mint (Token-2022). `mint::authority = config` is defense-in-depth
(see rationale on `MintOkuM::oku_money_mint`).

docs: User's USDC account

docs: User's OkuMoney account

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault

accounts.name: vault_oku_money
docs: PSM's OkuMoney escrow vault (for queued redemptions).
Pinned to `config.vault_oku_money` so a caller cannot substitute an
alternate config-owned OkuMoney ATA — without the explicit address
pin, any Token-2022 OkuMoney account whose authority is the config
PDA would satisfy the constraints and the user's escrowed tokens
would be silently routed away from the canonical escrow.

instructions.name: rescue_queue_entry
docs: Rescue a stuck queue entry — returns escrowed OkuMoney to recipient.
Only queue_processor can call (matches EVM's rescueQueueEntry).
`queue_index` is u64 — indexer / orchestrator code must pass
the index as a `BN`/bigint on the TS side.

accounts.name: redemption_queue
docs: Redemption queue (zero-copy). `rescue_queue_entry` uses `load_mut()`
after the CPI to clear the entry and advance the head ring.

accounts.name: oku_money_mint
docs: OkuMoney mint (Token-2022)

accounts.name: vault_oku_money
docs: PSM's OkuMoney escrow vault — holds queued redemptions

accounts.name: recipient_oku_money_ata
docs: Recipient's OkuMoney account (can be original user or alternate).
Must hold the configured OkuMoney mint and live under the Token-2022
program — without these constraints a `queue_processor` could be
tricked into transferring the escrowed OkuMoney into an account on the
wrong mint, surfacing only as an opaque SPL-layer error.

accounts.name: vault_oku_money
docs: PSM's OkuMoney escrow vault for queued redemptions
Holds OkuMoney while users are in queue (yield comes from price appreciation)

accounts.name: role_admin
docs: `role_admin` is the only authority permitted to create the queue PDA.
Without this gate, any signer could front-run the deployer and create
the canonical-seeded `RedemptionQueue` PDA, forcing the legitimate
`initialize` flow to fail with `AccountAlreadyInitialized` until the
griefer's account is closed. Matches the authority model used by
`SetupOkuMoneyEscrow` below.

accounts.name: config
docs: PSM config must exist (initialize was called).

accounts.name: unfreezer
docs: Unblacklister authority - can thaw even when PSM is paused (requires deliberate review)

accounts.name: oku_money_mint
docs: OkuMoney mint (Token-2022)

accounts.name: target_oku_money_ata
docs: Target account to thaw

instructions.name: user_self_rescue_queue_entry
docs: Permissionless self-rescue (cycle 4 / PSM-06).
Any user can reclaim their own queued OkuMoney without operator
involvement, unblocking the head-pin DoS where a frozen ATA on
the head entry stalls every subsequent `process_queue` call.
Signer must be the entry's original queued user; recipient ATA
must be owned by that user (constraints enforced on the
`UserSelfRescueQueueEntry` context).

accounts.name: recipient_oku_money_ata
docs: Recipient ATA — must be owned by `user` (enforced by
`token::authority = user`). Pinning the authority is what
distinguishes self-rescue from the privileged operator rescue
(which can target an arbitrary recipient).

docs: Redemption queue (read-only) — used to calculate reserved USDC for

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault (source)

types.name: AuthorityRole
docs: Authority roles that can be updated via set_authority.
These roles govern PSM-specific operations.

types.name: AuthorityUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when a PSM authority role is updated.
For `RoleAdmin` rotations this fires twice: once at proposal time
(`new_authority` = the *pending* admin, surfaced via
`RoleAdminTransferProposed` for indexers that want to distinguish the
two phases) and a second time on acceptance (`old_authority` = previous
admin, `new_authority` = newly accepted admin).

types.name: BufferDepositEvent
docs: Emitted when USDC is deposited into buffer.
EVM equivalent: `BufferDeposited(address indexed depositor, uint256 amount, uint256 newBufferBalance)`

fields.name: orchestrator
docs: Depositor (orchestrator)

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount deposited (6 decimals)

fields.name: new_buffer_balance
docs: New buffer balance after deposit

types.name: BufferRefilledEvent
docs: Emitted at the end of `process_queue` with batch-level summary.
EVM equivalent: `BufferRefilled(uint256 newBufferBalance,
uint256 processedCount, uint256 skippedCount)`. Indexers can use this
to reconcile buffer state after a queue drain without summing per-entry
`RedemptionProcessed`/`Skipped` events.

fields.name: new_buffer_balance
docs: USDC vault balance after the batch completed (6 decimals).

fields.name: processed_count
docs: Number of entries that received a USDC payout in this batch.
Bounded by `RedemptionQueue::MAX_BATCH_ENTRIES` (= 50) per call;
u64 matches the queue's u64 indices.

fields.name: skipped_count
docs: Number of cleared (rescued) entries skipped during traversal.

fields.name: actor
docs: Withdrawer (buffer_withdrawer role)

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount withdrawn (6 decimals)

fields.name: new_buffer_balance
docs: New buffer balance after withdrawal

fields.name: actor

types.name: EscrowInitializedEvent
docs: Emitted when the OkuMoney escrow vault is wired into config.
Cycle 4 (PSM-22): added so the final init step is observable.

types.name: FreezeEvent
docs: Emitted when an account is frozen.
EVM equivalent: `Blacklisted(address indexed account)`

types.name: InitializeEvent
docs: Emitted when PSM is initialized.
EVM equivalent: the `Initialized(uint64 version)` event from OZ's `Initializable`
(LitePSM is upgradeable; there is no Solidity constructor event).

types.name: InitializeParams
docs: Parameter bundle for [`initialize`]. Cycle 4 (PSM-17): collapses
the 15-argument instruction signature into a single struct so the
IDL slot is self-documenting and the call site is harder to
scramble (every field is named, not positional). Anchor borsh-
encodes the struct in a single byte run, so the wire format is
equivalent in size and shape to the prior positional args; only
the IDL changes (and only additively from the client's
perspective once the new struct is in their generated types).
All `*` pubkey fields are the granular on-chain authorities; see
`roles::AuthorityRole` for the role catalogue and
`audit/SVM/README.md` § "Trust model" for the warm-vs-cold matrix.

fields.name: actor

fields.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC buffer vault (ATA)

fields.name: vault_oku_money
docs: PSM's OkuMoney escrow vault for queued redemptions (ATA)
Holds OkuMoney while users are in queue (yield comes from price appreciation)

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Maximum OkuMoney supply cap

fields.name: minter_allowance
docs: Mint allowance remaining (configurable cap on freshly minted OkuMoney
between admin resets, mirroring the EVM `minterAllowance` pattern).

fields.name: is_paused
docs: Whether the PSM is paused

fields.name: last_yield_distribution_slot
docs: Solana slot of last yield distribution (sandwich prevention)
Operations like mint/redeem are blocked in the same slot as yield distribution

fields.name: oku_m_price
docs: Current OkuMoney price multiplier (1e9 = $1.00)
Updated by set_oku_m_price() or distribute_yield()
Matches EVM's okuMPrice() storage pattern

fields.name: pending_role_admin
docs: Pending `role_admin` rotation target — the two-step admin-transfer
model (OpenZeppelin `Ownable2Step` pattern). `set_authority(RoleAdmin,
new_admin)` writes to this slot only; the rotation does NOT take
effect until `new_admin` signs `accept_role_admin`, which moves the
value into `role_admin` and clears the slot. This protects the
protocol from a typo or stale key on the proposing side silently
locking out the meta-role.
`Pubkey::default()` means "no pending rotation".

fields.name: direct_minter
docs: Operator / fiat gateway — can mint OkuMoney directly without USDC.
EVM equivalent: address granted `OKUM_MINTER` role.
`Pubkey::default()` means "not configured / disabled".

fields.name: direct_minter_allowance
docs: Per-direct-minter allowance (separate from the USDC-backed
`minter_allowance`). Decremented on each direct mint; reset by
`allowance_manager` via `set_direct_minter_allowance`. Mirrors
EVM `minterAllowance[directMinter]`.

fields.name: direct_burner
docs: Operator / bridge backend — can burn OkuMoney directly without
triggering a USDC redemption.
EVM equivalent: address granted `OKUM_BURNER` role.
`Pubkey::default()` means "not configured / disabled".

fields.name: direct_burner_allowance
docs: Per-direct-burner allowance. Decremented on each direct burn;
reset by `allowance_manager` via `set_direct_burner_allowance`.
Mirrors EVM's role-gated burn with an additional allowance cap
for operational safety.

types.name: PsmConfigMigratedEvent
docs: Emitted when PsmConfig is migrated (realloc'd) to the new layout.

types.name: QueueEntry
docs: A single entry in the redemption queue.
`#[zero_copy]` is Anchor's marker for inner types embedded in
`#[account(zero_copy)]` accounts — derives `Pod` + `Zeroable` and
registers the type with the IDL. `#[repr(C)]` has no implicit
padding here (`Pubkey` is align-1, `u64`/`i64` align-8); the layout
is pinned to 48 bytes by the `assert!` below.

fields.name: user
docs: User who is owed redemption

fields.name: oku_m_amount
docs: OkuMoney amount held in escrow.
The actual USDC payout is calculated at `process_queue` time using
the current `oku_m_price` multiplier.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Timestamp when queued (kept for audit trail)

types.name: QueueInitializedEvent
docs: Emitted when the redemption-queue PDA is created. Cycle 4 (PSM-22):
added so the three-step init flow has full event coverage and
indexers can observe each setup leg landing on-chain.

fields.name: max_entries
docs: Compile-time queue capacity (`RedemptionQueue::MAX_ENTRIES`).

types.name: RedeemEvent
docs: Emitted when OkuMoney is redeemed for USDC (instant redemption).
EVM equivalent: `RedeemNote(address indexed user, uint256 okuMIn, uint256 usdcOut, uint256 okuMMultiplier)`

fields.name: user
docs: User who redeemed

fields.name: oku_m_amount
docs: OkuMoney burned (6 decimals)

fields.name: usdc_amount
docs: USDC received (6 decimals)

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: Dollar value of the redeemed amount

fields.name: oku_m_price
docs: OkuMoney price multiplier at time of redeem (1e9 = $1.00)
EVM equivalent: okuMMultiplier

fields.name: new_total_supply
docs: OkuMoney supply AFTER the burn completed. Cycle 4 (PSM-23).

types.name: RedemptionProcessedEvent
docs: Emitted when a queued redemption is processed.
EVM equivalent: `RedemptionProcessed(address indexed user, uint256 okuMAmount, uint256 dollarValue, uint256 usdcAmount, uint256 waitTime)`

fields.name: user
docs: User who received redemption

fields.name: oku_m_amount
docs: OkuMoney amount that was escrowed (6 decimals)

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: Dollar value at time of processing

fields.name: usdc_amount
docs: USDC received (6 decimals)

fields.name: wait_time
docs: Time spent in queue (seconds)

fields.name: new_total_supply
docs: OkuMoney supply AFTER the per-entry burn. Cycle 4 (PSM-23):
added so indexers can reconstruct supply trajectory through the
queue-drain phase without summing batch events. Note that
because `process_queue` emits one of these per processed entry,
the value decreases monotonically across the batch.

types.name: RedemptionQueue
docs: Redemption queue PDA — zero-copy ring buffer.
Uses `#[account(zero_copy)]` rather than `#[account]` so the 200-entry
array isn't Borsh-deserialised into a stack frame on every handler
entry. `AccountLoader<RedemptionQueue>` is the canonical access path;
`load_init` for `setup_redemption_queue`, `load` / `load_mut`
elsewhere with the borrow strictly scoped before any CPI.
**Why 200 entries.** Solana caps CPI-driven account allocations at
`MAX_PERMITTED_DATA_INCREASE = 10_240` bytes per call (Anchor's `init`
constraint goes through `system_program::create_account`). 200
entries × 48 B = 9 600 B fits with 600 B of headroom; a single-step
`setup_redemption_queue` would otherwise require a `init + realloc +
realloc` flow. See `SVM/README.md` § "EVM vs SVM — divergence
catalogue" for the EVM divergence note.
Wire layout (`#[repr(C)]`, packed to native alignment):
```text
8   Anchor discriminator
1   bump
7   _pad0  (align head to 8)
8   head
8   tail
8   total_queued_oku_m
48 * 200   entries
compile-time `assert!` below.
Field-access rules:
- Use `AccountLoader<RedemptionQueue>` in contexts, never
`Account<RedemptionQueue>` — the latter would attempt to Borsh-deserialize
the whole struct into a stack frame and overflow.
- `load()` for read-only, `load_mut()` for read-write. Drop the borrow
before any CPI that re-borrows the account info (the borrow is a
runtime `RefCell` borrow under the hood).
- `load_init()` only at the one `init`-constraint site
(`setup_redemption_queue`).
Seeds: `["redemption_queue_v2"]`. Rotation history tracked in
`SVM/README.md` § "PDA seed history".

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed

fields.name: _pad0
docs: Padding so `head` lands on an 8-byte boundary. Reserved; do not use.

fields.name: head
docs: Index of next entry to process (head of queue). u64 so the
absolute counter is effectively unbounded
(~5.8 × 10¹⁰ years at 100 enqueues/sec); ring-buffer position
is `RedemptionQueue::ring_index(head)`.

fields.name: tail
docs: Index of next slot to write (tail of queue).

fields.name: total_queued_oku_m
docs: Running total of OkuMoney held in escrow (updated on
enqueue/process/rescue).

fields.name: entries
docs: Ring-buffer entries. Index into via
`entries[(head_or_tail % MAX_ENTRIES) as usize]`.

types.name: RedemptionQueuedEvent
docs: Emitted when a redemption is queued (insufficient buffer).
EVM equivalent: `RedemptionQueued(address indexed user, uint256 okuMAmount, uint256 dollarValue, uint256 position, uint256 queueLength)`

fields.name: user
docs: User who is owed redemption

fields.name: oku_m_amount
docs: OkuMoney amount held in escrow (6 decimals)

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: Dollar value at time of queueing

fields.name: queue_position
docs: Position in queue (0-indexed; absolute tail index, not ring slot).

fields.name: queue_length
docs: Total queue length after this entry.

types.name: RedemptionRescuedEvent
docs: Emitted when a stuck queue entry is rescued.
EVM equivalent: `RedemptionRescued(uint256 indexed index, address originalUser, address recipient, uint256 okuMAmount, uint256 dollarValue)`

fields.name: queue_index
docs: Absolute index of the rescued entry.

fields.name: original_user
docs: Original user who was owed redemption

fields.name: recipient
docs: Recipient who received the OkuMoney

fields.name: oku_m_amount
docs: OkuMoney amount returned (6 decimals)

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: Dollar value at time of rescue

types.name: RedemptionSkippedEvent
docs: Emitted when `process_queue` skips a previously-rescued entry.
EVM equivalent: `RedemptionSkipped(uint256 indexed index)`.

fields.name: queue_index
docs: Absolute queue index that was skipped (already cleared by rescue).

types.name: RoleAdminTransferAcceptedEvent
docs: Emitted when `accept_role_admin` completes a previously-proposed
two-step transfer.

types.name: RoleAdminTransferCancelledEvent
docs: Emitted when `cancel_role_admin_transfer` clears an in-flight proposal.

types.name: RoleAdminTransferProposedEvent
docs: Emitted when `set_authority(RoleAdmin, ...)` proposes a two-step
transfer of the meta-role. The rotation has NOT taken effect — the new
admin must still sign `accept_role_admin` to commit it.

types.name: ThawEvent
docs: Emitted when an account is unfrozen.
EVM equivalent: `Unblacklisted(address indexed account)`

types.name: UnpauseEvent
docs: Emitted when PSM is unpaused.
EVM equivalent: `Unpaused(address account)`

types.name: YieldDistributed
docs: Emitted when yield is distributed across all OkuMoney holders.
EVM equivalent: `YieldDistributed(uint256 yieldAmount, uint256 oldMultiplier, uint256 newMultiplier, uint256 totalSupply)`

fields.name: yield_amount
docs: Dollar yield distributed (6 decimals)

fields.name: total_supply
docs: Total OkuMoney supply at time of distribution

types.name: YieldDistributionSlotSet
docs: Emitted when yield distribution slot is set (for sandwich prevention).
